title: Arcane Blade Charger
summary: Arcane Blade Charger is an Arcane Enhancement that provides a 30% chance on killing an enemy with a primary weapon to increase the damage of melee for 12 seconds.
extract:
Arcane Blade Charger is an Arcane Enhancement that provides a 30% chance on killing an enemy with a primary weapon to increase the damage of melee for 12 seconds.
Can be sold for  ‍1,000.

Effect

Acquisition
Awarded from Arbitrations missions.
Can be purchased from the Arbitrations vendor in the  Arbiters of Hexis room in Relays for 10  Vitus Essence.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.

Notes
The buff is additive to damage mods.
For example,  Skana with max  Pressure Point and 200% bonus from  Arcane Blade Charger will have: 120.0 × (1 + 120% + 200%) = 504 damage
